name: Slime Castle - Throne Room
description: A large hall with a green throne in the center

npcs.description: A massive pile of gelatinous goo adorned with two huge eyes

name: Slime Castle - Grand Stairs
description: The grandest of stairs

name: Slime Castle - Courtyard
description: A desolate courtyard littered with dead trees

exits.description: A crack in the wall contains hints of green

name: Slime Castle - Hidden Grove
description: A cluster of greenery

exits.description: (C)rawl through the crack in the wall

npcs.description: A playful Dalmatian

name: Slime Castle - Gate
description: A gate of fair size. It's open to a bright clearing that shimmers like a mirage.

exits.description: (O)ut into the clearing, past the point of no return

npcs.description: Looks kinda intimidating with that oversized helmet

name: Slime Castle - King's Chambers
description: Looks like a big ol' king lives here

name: Slime Castle - Kitchen
description: A number of pots and pans are strewn about -- aparently unused in years

npcs.description: Chef slime best slime

name: Slime Castle - Guest Quarters
description: A stone room replete with several piles of hay

npcs.description: Fast asleep amidst a haypile

name: ??? - Cave
description: A dark and unfamiliar cave

exits.description: Through a faint (p)ortal in the back of the cave

npcs.description: This crab looks like it's prepared for battle

actions: snips its claws in the air.

name: Slime Forest - Mossy Clearing
description:
A large oblong clearing covered in shimmering green moss.
While the space appears clear, you can't seem to pass through it.

exits.description: An invisible barrier prevents you from moving through the center
(W)est on a path through a sparser part of the forest
(D)elve into the densest swath of trees

name: Slime Forest - Path - Crossroads
description:
A three way intersection of light dirt paths meandering through the bright forest.
Peaceful chirping echoes from the west.
An eerie silence drifts from the north, overdubbed by a whisper of wind from the south.

exits.description: (W)est towards the sounds of peaceful nature
(E)ast towards a nondescript section of trees
Into a large (c)learing off the path

npcs.description: Angry eyes shift rapidly on this dark green pile of goo

name: Slime Forest - Western Edge
description:
Trees and foliage crowd together unnaturally tightly, the sun darkened by their overhanging branches.
The ground grows soft and damp underfoot. Hints of tangy vegetation drift from somewhere close by.

exits.description: (W)est, into the sudden hush of the swamp

npcs.description: The eyes of this surprisingly bright-colored slime betray nothing.

name: Slime Forest - Path - Sunlit Verge
description:
The trees begin to thin here, patches of open sky breaking through the canopy more often than not.
Grass creeps in thick clumps along the path's edges, wildflowers pushing up between the exposed roots.

npcs.description: This green slime seems shinier than usual.

name: Slime Forest - Path - Grassy Threshold
description:
The last of the trees give way here, thin trunks scattered among grass grown thick and unruly.
The ground firms considerably underfoot, the path continuing clearly to the east.

exits.description: (E)ast, where the trees open fully onto farmland

npcs.description: Dirt and bits of dry grass fleck this green slime, giving it a mottled brown-and-green look.

name: Slime Forest - Path - Bright Patch
description:
Trees are sparse here, causing the sun to shine particularly brightly.
The path is illuminated before you.

npcs.description: This particularly small slime appears quite frustrated with your appearance
Have you seen this slime before?

name: Slime Forest - Path - Breezy Incline
description:
The path darkens slightly here as maple and birch trees give way to a growing number of pines.
The path angles lightly, inclining towards a light wind which gently knudges travelers back down the slope.

exits.description: Push against the wind and (u)p the incline

npcs.description: A remarkably spherical ball of goo that's having trouble maintaining its balance on this curved terrain

name: Slime Forest - Path - Pine Lane
description:
The growing number of pines press against the path. Its angle sharpens here,
as if it and the forest are funneling you away from this hill.

npcs.description: Wandering aimlessly, this slime occasionally gurgles angrily to itself.
A sentient goo pile that darts from tree trunk to tree trunk, blending with its surroundings.

name: Slime Forest - Path - Chilly Bluff
description: An exposed dirt and rock area only sparsely populated with trees.

npcs.description: This gelatinous blob has depressions speckling its outside, giving the appearance of pockmarks

name: Tableland - Path - Northern Edge
description:
A narrow dirt trail winding over a wide stretch of plains that's encompassed on three
sides by distant mountains. One end of the path disappears at a cliff to the north,
the other into a seemingly endless expanse of dirt and dry grass.

exits.description: (S)outh, down the switchback onto the plateau

name: Tableland - Path - Rocky Switchback
description:
The cliffside trail zigzags sharply downward, red dust sliding loose underfoot with every step.
Below, the plateau opens into a hazy expanse the color of rust.

exits.description: (U)p the switchback, toward the forest's edge
(D)own the last stretch onto level ground

name: Tableland - Path - Windswept Flat
description:
A broad, sun-bleached flat stretches in every direction, the wind here constant and dry.
Worn paths radiate outward like cracks in old pottery -- west into broken stone, east toward a haze of heat, and south into the plateau's depths.

exits.description: (W)est toward a field of cracked stone
(E)ast where the air shimmers with heat

npcs.description: A loose column of dust and air that drifts a few feet off the ground, unbothered by the wind

actions: spins lazily in place, scattering a little dust.

name: Tableland - Path - Cracked Mesa Trail
description:
The ground here has split into a maze of dry, sun-cracked plates, each one shifting slightly underfoot.
The trail threads carefully between them.

exits.description: (W)est into the heart of the cracked stone

name: Tableland - Path - Cracked Mesa
description: Slabs of rust-colored rock jut up at odd angles, as if the ground itself buckled long ago.

npcs.description: A hunched shape of packed dust and stone that rises from a crack when it senses movement

actions: grinds upright, shedding a hiss of dust.

name: Tableland - Path - Crumbling Ledge
description:
The trail narrows to a ledge that crumbles a little more with every gust of wind.
Far below, the plateau falls away into shadow.

npcs.description: Coalesced air swirls at the ledge's edge, daring you to get closer

name: Tableland - Path - Fissure Crossing
description:
A series of narrow fissures split the ground here, some no wider than a footstep, others wide enough to swallow one.
A faint, dry whistling rises from below.

npcs.description: A thin wisp of dust that darts between the fissures, more curious than dangerous

name: Tableland - Path - Sunbaked Trail
description:
Heat rises visibly off the rock here, bending the horizon into a shimmer.
The trail presses on regardless.

name: Tableland - Path - Sunbaked Hollow
description: A shallow depression in the rock offers a sliver of shade, though little relief from the heat.

npcs.description: A playful gust that keeps snatching at loose items and darting away

actions: tugs at your belongings, then giggles away.

name: Tableland - Path - Baked Overlook
description:
The trail ends at a scorched overlook, the rock underfoot cracked from some long-ago heat.
The view stretches for miles, empty and red.

npcs.description: A sentinel of compressed air that seems to watch the horizon more than you

name: Tableland - Path - Long Stretch
description: The path runs straight and flat for a long while, wind hissing steadily across the open ground.

name: Tableland - Path - Weathered Crossroads
description:
Four paths meet here at a crossroads worn smooth by countless footsteps.
Faint chanting drifts in from the east, and the trail south feels somehow colder despite the sun.

npcs.description: A weathered traveler crouched at the crossroads, tracing shapes in the dust with a stick

actions: Another one, drawn south. They always are.

name: Tableland - Path - Sunken Trail
description: The trail dips into a shallow basin here, the wind cutting off abruptly and leaving an odd stillness.

npcs.description: A cultist sits cross-legged in the stillness, eyes closed, unbothered by your presence

name: Tableland - Path - Cultist Byway
description:
Faded markings, half worn away by wind and sand, line this stretch of trail.
Steady chanting hums from somewhere unseen.

exits.description: (E)ast toward the source of the chanting

name: Tableland - Ritual Circle - Outskirts
description:
A ring of weathered standing stones marks the outer edge of a ritual site.
Robed figures move between them, their chanting low and steady.

npcs.description: A wary acolyte watches the outskirts, more curious than hostile

name: Tableland - Ritual Circle - Outer Ring
description:
The standing stones grow denser here, arranged in a wide, deliberate ring.
The chanting is no longer distant -- it surrounds you.

npcs.description: A zealous cultist bars the way forward, robes marked with unfamiliar sigils

actions: The circle is not for outsiders.

name: Tableland - Ritual Circle - Bonfire Camp
description:
A modest camp surrounds a low bonfire, its smoke bending sideways in the wind.
Pots and bundled supplies suggest the cultists here have settled in for a long stay.

exits.description: (E)ast into a hush of quiet chanting

npcs.description: A cultist tends the fire without looking up, unconcerned with anything beyond the flames

name: Tableland - Ritual Circle - Inner Sanctum
description: At the center of the ring stands a slab of dark, wind-polished stone, ringed by a hush deeper than silence should allow.

npcs.description: An elder cultist presides over the slab, voice never wavering, eyes never opening

actions: You are early. Or perhaps, right on time.

name: Tableland - Path - Southbound Trail
description: The crossroads falls behind as the trail presses south, the plateau's red dust deepening into a darker shade.

exits.description: (S)outh, where the ground begins to change

name: Tableland - Path - Sparse Grass
description:
Thin blades of grass have begun to push up through the cracked earth here, the first sign of anything green since the forest.
The trail forks, one branch continuing south, another curving west toward scorched ground.

npcs.description: A restless gust of air kicks up loose dust and grass in equal measure

name: Tableland - Path - Southern Edge
description:
The trail thins and fades, the plateau's dust giving way at last to something greener and unfamiliar in the distance.
The way forward is not yet worn.

npcs.description: A cultist scout crouches at the border, watching whatever lies beyond with open suspicion

actions: eyes you warily, hand resting on a weapon at their hip.

name: Tableland - Path - Fractured Trail
description: A narrow trail splits off from the ritual site, the ground here fractured into long, shallow trenches.

exits.description: (S)outh toward a lighter sound of song

name: Tableland - Sunlit Shrine - Outskirts
description:
The trenches give way to open ground and a small shrine bathed in unusually bright light.
The air here feels warmer, gentler than the rest of the plateau.

npcs.description: A calm devotee sits at the shrine's edge, humming a quiet tune

name: Tableland - Sunlit Shrine - Prayer Ring
description:
A ring of pale stones surrounds a modest altar, kept clean of the plateau's ever-present dust.
Several devotees kneel here in quiet prayer.

npcs.description: A young acolyte prays quietly, opening one eye to note your arrival before continuing

name: Tableland - Sunlit Shrine - Sanctum
description:
The shrine's innermost chamber holds a small, sunlit altar, the only structure on the plateau that seems entirely at peace.
Even the wind is gentler here.

npcs.description: The shrine keeper watches you approach with calm, appraising eyes -- not hostile, but not entirely trusting either

name: Tableland - Path - Scorched Flat
description: The ground here is blackened and glassy in patches, as if scorched by something far hotter than the sun.

npcs.description: A column of superheated air shimmers where it stands, the ground beneath it faintly smoking

name: Tableland - Path - Whispering Stones
description:
A scatter of small stones here hums faintly in the wind, each one carrying a different note.
The effect is unsettling more than musical.

name: Tableland - Path - Wind Scoured Bluff
description: The plateau rises to its highest point here, scoured bare by wind that never seems to stop.

npcs.description: A towering, near-solid column of wind and grit that dwarfs anything else you've seen on the plateau

actions: roars, a sound made entirely of wind.

name: Tableland - Path - Forgotten Altar
description:
A cracked altar sits half-buried in drifted dust, its carvings worn past recognition.
Something about it feels deliberately abandoned.

npcs.description: A lone cultist picks through the altar's ruins, hostile to anyone who might take what they've found

name: Tableland - Path - Eastern Overlook
description: A narrow spur climbs to a second overlook, quieter than the first, facing further east.

npcs.description: A small gust that circles the overlook in lazy loops

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Western Edge
description:
The forest thins abruptly here, dark trunks giving way to open sky and the smell of turned earth.
A worn cart path continues east into farmland; the tree line waits close behind to the west.

exits.description: (W)est, into the darker press of the forest
(E)ast, along the cart path into open country

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Furrowed Field
description:
Neat furrows of tilled soil stretch alongside the path, though no farmer is in sight.
A scatter of mice work busily among the exposed roots of a smattering of oak trees.

npcs.description: A skittering knot of small brown bodies, more numerous than any one of them is dangerous.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Grazing Slope
description:
The land rises into a broad, grassy slope dotted with grazing animals and the occasional half-buried stone.
Wind moves through the grass in long, slow waves.

npcs.description: A shaggy goat that eyes you with mild, chewing indifference.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Fence Line
description:
A low wooden fence runs the length of the path, its posts weathered to a soft grey -- except for one stretch, trampled flat.
Beyond it, the pasture rolls on unbroken.

npcs.description: A bull, broad and heavily muscled, paces the length of the trampled fence, unable to find its way back through.

actions: lowers its head and stamps a hoof, penned in and furious.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Cart Track
description:
Deep ruts mark where heavy carts have passed this way many times before.
Boulders, some as large as a person, sit scattered to either side.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Boulder Field
description: Enormous boulders crowd together here, remnants of some ancient upheaval, forming natural corridors between them.

exits.description: (E)ast, past the last of the boulders
(N)orth into a cluster of lichen-crusted stones

npcs.description: A mottled lizard the color of the stone it suns itself on.

actions: flicks its tongue and eyes you warily from atop a sun-warmed stone.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Lichen-Crusted Stones
description: Thick lichen, orange and pale green, blankets a knot of smaller stones tucked among the boulders.

npcs.description: A thick-set badger plants itself in front of its den, claws already digging into the dirt.

actions: snarls low and doesn't budge an inch.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Hedgerow
description:
A tangled hedgerow marks the boundary of some long-abandoned field, thick enough to hide most of what moves through it.
Crows scold you from its upper branches.

npcs.description: A dozen ravens burst up screaming from the hedge at once, wings and beaks a single black storm.

actions: erupts from the hedge in a shrieking black cloud.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Grain Silo Ruins
description:
A collapsed grain silo leans against the hillside, its wooden staves long since rotted through.
Birds have claimed what's left of it.

npcs.description: A cluster of crows crowd the silo's broken rafters, unwilling to give up the perch.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Windswept Rise
description:
The hill crests into a rise with a long view over the farmland below.
A wind-bent tree leans over a worn path at its peak.

exits.description: (E)ast, down the far side of the rise

npcs.description: A stooped shepherd who watches the fields more closely than he watches you.

actions: adjusts his hat and returns his gaze to the fields, paying you no further mind.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Old Scarecrow Post
description: A scarecrow leans at an unnatural angle against its post, straw spilling from a tear in its side.

npcs.description: A crudely stitched scarecrow that shouldn't be standing upright, let alone watching you.

actions: jerks its head a fraction too far to watch you pass.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Sunken Lane
description:
The path dips into a sunken lane worn deep by the repeated passage of something heavy and four-legged, high grass banks pressing close on either side.
It ends abruptly in a wallow of churned mud and flattened grass.

npcs.description: A bristling, tusked boar that paws at the dirt, unwilling to yield the lane.

actions: snorts and paws at the churned mud, unwilling to yield its wallow.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Drystone Wall
description:
A drystone wall, stacked without mortar, runs alongside the path for a considerable stretch.
A gap in the stones offers a shortcut off the main track.

exits.description: (E)ast, where the wall opens onto a wider crossroads
Squeeze through the (g)ap in the wall

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Weathered Waystone
description:
A small, weather-worn statue stands half-swallowed by weeds beyond the gap, one hand raised in a blessing no one alive remembers the meaning of.
A few wilted flowers rest at its base, left more recently than the statue's condition would suggest.

exits.description: Squeeze through the (g)ap in the wall

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Weathered Crossroads
description: Several cart paths converge here around a cracked stone marker, its carved directions worn nearly illegible.

npcs.description: A road-worn peddler minding a cart of dubious wares.

actions: Downs-grown wares, best this side of the forest! ...Buying, are you? No? Suit yourself.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Bramblewood Bend
description:
The path narrows sharply where bramble has grown thick and unchecked across it.
Thorns catch at your sleeve with every step.

npcs.description: A scarred, heavyset boar, larger and warier than its younger kin down the slope.

actions: crashes free of the bramble, tusks lowered.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Town Approach
description:
The cart track widens and firms into a proper road here, worn smooth by regular traffic.
Rooftops and chimney smoke are visible ahead.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Stonesway
description:
Flat standing stones, spaced with obvious intention, mark this path like a row of silent sentries.
The air feels a few degrees cooler here than it should.

npcs.description: A jackdaw perched atop one of the standing stones, croaking an unpleasant warning.

actions: shifts along the stone, croaking a single unpleasant note.

name: Seneca Downs - Standing Stones Circle
description:
A ring of ancient standing stones crowns a low rise, their surfaces carved with symbols too weathered to read.
At the center, a wide crack in the earth descends into darkness.

exits.description: (D)own into the crack in the earth

npcs.description: A fragment of animate stone, humanoid in shape, that shudders faintly whenever you draw close.

actions: shudders faintly as you pass, stone dust sifting from an old crack in its chest.

name: Seneca Downs - Path - Moss-Grown Outlier
description: A single standing stone rests apart from the circle, half-swallowed by moss and creeping vine.

npcs.description: A slim, patterned adder that lifts its head at your approach but doesn't strike.

actions: lifts its head and flicks its tongue at your approach.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Approach
description:
The road opens into a small square lined with modest stone-and-timber buildings.
Smoke curls from several chimneys despite the mild afternoon.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Plaza
description: Seneca Town's small plaza sits at the heart of the settlement, a well at its center ringed by a few benches.

exits.description: Head to the (p)ost near the gate

npcs.description: A guard out of uniform but not out of habit, still watching the road out of the corner of one eye.

actions: straightens up briefly as you pass, then relaxes against the well again.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - General Store
description:
Shelves crowded with dry goods, rope, and farm tools line the walls of the town's general store.
The smell of grain dust hangs thick in the air.

npcs.description: A wiry shopkeeper who counts stock under his breath, barely glancing up.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Smithy
description:
Heat rolls off a low forge at the back of the smithy, and the ring of hammer on iron never quite stops.
Horseshoes and farm implements hang from every available hook.

npcs.description: A broad-shouldered smith, forearms streaked with soot, who works without looking up from the anvil.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Inn
description: A low fire crackles in the common room of the town's only inn, a handful of tables scattered before it.

npcs.description: A tired-looking innkeeper who greets you more out of routine than enthusiasm.

actions: glances up from the bar just long enough to nod.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Inn Back Rooms
description:
A short hall off the common room leads to a handful of small, curtained sleeping alcoves, currently empty.
A ledger by the door lists room rates in a cramped hand.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Sunken Stairwell
description:
Rough-hewn stone steps spiral down from the crack in the standing stones into cold, still air.
Torchlight soot still clings blackened to the walls, circling empty sconces.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Root-Choked Passage
description: Massive roots have broken through the ceiling here, snaking down the walls in search of moisture that isn't there.

npcs.description: A writhing mass of oversized cave rats that scatter and regroup as one.

actions: scatters and regroups in a writhing, chittering mass as you approach.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Fungal Antechamber
description:
Pale, faintly luminous fungus blankets every surface of this wide chamber, casting everything in a sickly glow.
The air is thick with spores.

npcs.description: A slow, glowing mass of fungal growth that pulses faintly as it drags itself forward.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Collapsed Alcove
description:
A side chamber has partially collapsed, rubble burying whatever it once held.
A fragment of worked stone, etched with a golem's sigil, juts inert from the debris -- whatever animated it clearly isn't here anymore.

npcs.description: A cluster of stone-boring grubs, fat and pale, nest in the gaps between the fallen rubble.

actions: writhe and scatter briefly across the stone, then resettle.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Cracked Gallery
description:
A long gallery runs deeper into the barrow, its ceiling fractured in a dozen places by some old tremor.
Dust sifts down steadily from above.

exits.description: (D)own toward the sound of stone on stone

npcs.description: A crude assembly of loose stone that drags itself along on uneven, rock-hewn limbs.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Golem Foundry
description:
Rows of half-finished stone golems stand frozen mid-construction in what must once have been a forge for them.
One, closer to complete than the rest, turns its head as you enter.

npcs.description: A stone golem, more complete than the frozen ranks around it, its joints grinding as it turns to face you.

actions: grinds slowly to face you, one arm still fused to the stone it was carved from.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Chiseling Chamber
description:
Chisels, mallets, and half-carved stone litter this small workroom, abandoned mid-task.
A faint, cold presence seems to linger over the unfinished work.

npcs.description: A translucent, hunched figure that keeps chiseling at stone that isn't really there.

actions: flickers into view mid-swing, chiseling stone that isn't there.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Descending Stair
description:
A narrow stair cut directly into the rock spirals further down into cold, still air.
The sound of shifting stone echoes up from below.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Bone-Littered Hall
description: Old bones, human and otherwise, are scattered across the floor of this long hall.

npcs.description: A withered, upright corpse that rises unsteadily from among the bones as you approach.

actions: stirs among the bones, rising unsteadily to face you.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Sealed Alcove
description: A stone door, its ancient seal fractured by some old tremor, stands ajar just wide enough to slip through into a small alcove beyond.

npcs.description: A pitted, ancient golem, still standing at rigid attention centuries after its post was forgotten.

actions: stands rigid and silent, but its eyes seem to track your every movement.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Threshold of the Barrow King
description: A wide archway, carved with the same sigils seen throughout the barrow, marks the threshold to its deepest chamber.

npcs.description: A massive golem, more intact than any other seen in the barrow, planted immovably before the archway.

actions: plants itself immovably in the archway, stone grinding against stone.

name: Seneca Downs - Barrow Depths - Barrow King's Chamber
description: A cavernous chamber opens at the heart of the barrow, dominated by a throne of fused stone and bone.

npcs.description: A colossal, throned figure of living rock, moss and lichen grown into the cracks of untold centuries.

actions: Who dares wake the King of Stone?

name: Morass - Path - Eastern Edge
description:
The forest's undergrowth is soaked through here, giving way at the edges to black standing water and reeds.
The tree line is still visible to the east; the ground disappears into the swamp to the west.

name: Morass - Path - Waterlogged Trail
description: The path has all but dissolved into standing water, forcing you to pick your way between half-submerged roots.

npcs.description: A knot of fat leeches, drawn instantly to the warmth of anything living.

actions: ripples toward the warmth of your footsteps.

name: Morass - Path - Reed-Choked Clearing
description:
Reeds taller than a person crowd this shallow clearing, swaying though there's no wind to move them.
The ground squelches unpleasantly with every step.

npcs.description: A bloated frog with mottled green-brown skin, croaking at a pitch that sets your teeth on edge.

name: Morass - Path - False Trail
description: A dry-looking path leads invitingly north, though it curves back on itself in a way that leaves you disoriented.

npcs.description: A cold, drifting light that seems to know exactly how far to stay ahead of you.

actions: drifts closer, then further, matching your every step without ever quite approaching.

name: Morass - Path - Twisting Channel
description: A narrow channel of black water winds south in tight, unnatural switchbacks.

npcs.description: A sodden, oversized rat that swims more easily than it walks.

actions: splashes away through the shallows, then circles back.

name: Morass - Path - Sucking Mudflat
description:
The ground here has the consistency of thick porridge, pulling at your boots with every step.
A misstep here could easily cost you a boot, or worse.

exits.description: (W)est, toward a stand of dead trees

name: Morass - Path - Drowned Grove
description:
A stand of dead trees rises from the standing water, their bare branches hung with curtains of moss.
The air is thick with the whine of unseen insects.

exits.description: (W)est, past the last of the drowned trees
(N)orth across a tangle of exposed roots

npcs.description: A mosquito the size of a small bird, its proboscis glinting wetly.

name: Morass - Path - Tangled Root Bridge
description: A crude bridge of tangled roots spans a stretch of deeper water, sagging alarmingly underfoot.

npcs.description: A thick-bodied serpent, patterned to vanish perfectly among the roots it hides in.

actions: uncoils slightly from among the roots, tasting the air.

name: Morass - Path - Half-Sunken Log
description: An enormous fallen tree, half-submerged, offers the only dry footing for some distance in any direction.

npcs.description: A slick, dark adder coiled comfortably in the log's rotted-out hollow.

actions: shifts in its hollow, unwilling to give up its perch.

name: Morass - Path - Deep Mire
description:
The water deepens here into a proper mire, thick with algae and the smell of decay. Thick roots, too large for any swamp tree, break the surface further out.
A half-submerged footbridge, more suggestion than structure, continues on.

npcs.description: A many-legged, mud-caked thing that moves with unsettling patience through the muck.

name: Morass - Path - Sinking Footbridge
description:
The footbridge groans and dips lower with every step, threatening to give way entirely.
Below, the mire shows no bottom at all. Far ahead, past the bridge, the swamp's reeds give way to something greener and denser.

name: Morass - Sunken Shrine Clearing
description:
A ring of higher, drier ground surrounds a half-sunken stone shrine, moss-choked and long abandoned.
A crude idol, more mud than stone now, watches over a dark opening in the ground beside it.

exits.description: (D)own into the opening beside the idol

npcs.description: A crude idol, mostly reclaimed by moss and mud, that seems to watch more than a statue should.

actions: seems to track your movement, though its stone eyes haven't moved in centuries.

name: Morass - Path - Last Dry Hummock
description: A small hummock of solid ground rises just above the waterline, the last dry footing before the swamp reclaims everything.

npcs.description: A frog the size of a dog, skin glistening with an oily, toxic sheen.

actions: shifts its bulk and croaks a low, wet warning.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Sudden Drop
description:
The ground gives way beneath the idol without warning, dropping you into a passage carved through solid, suspended mud.
The walls hold their shape by no logic you can name.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Trench Passage
description:
The passage narrows uncomfortably, its mud walls glistening and faintly warm to the touch.
Footprints, too many to be one creature's, crisscross the floor.

npcs.description: A vaguely humanoid shape of animate mud, low to the ground and quick to duck from sight.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Suspended Mud Junction
description: Passages branch off in three directions here, the mud walls impossibly overhanging without collapsing.

npcs.description: A humanoid column of mud, unmoving except to track your every step.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Narrow Cut
description:
The trench narrows here to little more than a crawlspace, mud pressing close on every side.
The droning hum of insects grows suddenly deafening.

npcs.description: A dense, droning cloud of mosquitoes moving as a single hungry mass.

actions: rises off the walls in a single droning mass.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Bending Channel
description:
The passage bends sharply, then sharply again, in a way that leaves you uncertain which direction you started from.
Water drips steadily from unseen cracks above.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Waterlogged Alcove
description: A wider alcove opens here, its floor pooled ankle-deep with stagnant water.

npcs.description: A frog even larger than its swamp-surface kin, pale from a life spent entirely underground.

actions: shifts in the shadow of the far wall, eyes catching what little light there is.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Dead Reckoning
description:
The passage simply stops here, mud walls closing in on all sides with no way forward.
Countless overlapping marks have been scratched into the wall, as if keeping count.

npcs.description: A mud person that mutters wordlessly to itself, tracing the same wall markings over and over.

actions: keeps tracing the same marks, muttering wordlessly.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Suspended Corridor
description:
The trench opens briefly into a long, straight corridor, its mud ceiling arching improbably overhead.
The air here is colder than anywhere else in the trench.

npcs.description: A slick, segmented creature that clings to the mud walls as easily as the floor.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Mud Person Enclave
description: The passage widens into a rough enclave lined with crude, mud-formed dwellings.

npcs.description: An elder mud person, more sculpted than its kin, watching you with unmistakable intent.

actions: The surface-born should not have found their way down here.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Final Stretch
description:
The trench begins to slope steadily downward here, the air growing thick and close.
A cloud of insects thickens ahead, drawn to something deeper in the dark.

npcs.description: A churning, near-solid cloud of biting insects that parts and reforms around you.

actions: thickens around you, drawn to the warmth of your blood.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Sunken Antechamber
description: The passage opens into a wide, low antechamber, its mud walls streaked with something dark and old.

npcs.description: A shifting, half-formed shape of mud and shadow, barely holding a humanoid outline.

actions: gathers itself out of the shadow at the chamber's edge.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Heart of the Trenches
description: The trench opens into a vast, cathedral-like hollow at its very heart, walls of suspended mud arching high overhead.

npcs.description: A towering, roughly humanoid mass of living mud, ancient beyond reckoning.

actions: The mud remembers every bone it swallows. Yours will be no different.

name: Morass - Path - Vine-Choked Crossing
description:
Beyond the footbridge the mire firms up slightly, but thick vines now hang low across the path, slick with condensation.
The air smells suddenly, unmistakably, of green growing things rather than rot.

npcs.description: A vine that moves with far more purpose than any plant should, coiling toward exposed skin.

name: Morass - Path - Creeping Canopy
description:
Broad-leafed canopy closes overhead here, dimming the swamp's grey light to a mottled green gloom.
The mud underfoot is giving way, slowly, to matted roots and leaf litter.

npcs.description: A large, patient spider that keeps to the shadows of the canopy overhead.

actions: drops silently on a thread of silk, then vanishes back into the canopy just as fast.

name: Morass - Path - Buttress Root Hollow
description: Enormous buttress roots fan out from a tree too large to see the top of, forming a shallow, sheltered hollow between them.

npcs.description: A toad the mottled color of old bark, nearly invisible against the roots until it moves.

actions: croaks once, low and wet, from somewhere among the roots.

name: Morass - Path - Thickening Undergrowth
description:
The undergrowth thickens abruptly into something closer to jungle than swamp, ferns and broad leaves crowding out the last of the reeds.
The ground, at least, has finally gone solid underfoot.

exits.description: (W)est, where the jungle grows denser still

npcs.description: A slender green serpent, patterned to vanish perfectly among the hanging vines.

name: Morass - Path - Fern-Choked Alcove
description: Ferns taller than a person crowd this small alcove, their fronds trembling though the air is still.

npcs.description: A beetle the size of a shield, its carapace gleaming an iridescent green-black.

actions: shoulders free of the ferns, carapace clicking.

name: Morass - Path - Western Edge
description:
The last of the swamp finally gives way to true jungle here, dense and loud with unfamiliar calls.
A narrow game trail continues west into the deeper green; the mire lies quieter to the east.

exits.description: (E)ast, into the thinning jungle and toward the swamp

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Flooded Nook
description: A low nook branches off the junction, flooded ankle-deep with water that never quite drains.

npcs.description: A leech grown fat and pale on whatever wanders too close to the flooded nook.

actions: surfaces briefly, then sinks back beneath the still water.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Root-Pierced Wall
description:
A tangle of massive roots has pierced clean through the mud wall here, reaching down from the jungle far above.
The wood looks as out of place here as anything could.

npcs.description: A thing that might once have been root, now animate and hungry, coiled tight around the intrusion.

name: Morass - Swamp Trenches - Mud Person Nursery
description:
A quiet side-chamber holds a scatter of small hollows scooped into the mud, tended by unseen hands.
The air here feels watched in a way the rest of the enclave doesn't.

npcs.description: A small, still-forming mud person, more curious than hostile, but no less unsettling.

actions: peers out from among its kin, curious rather than afraid.

name: Seneca Downs - Seneca Town - Guard Post
description: A small guardhouse stands near the plaza, little more than a rack of spears, a locked cabinet, and a much-used dartboard just inside the door.

npcs.description: A weathered guard captain who watches the door more than she watches you.

actions: State your business, traveler. The barrow's been restless again.
